title: MECI: Multi-Element Collaborative Interaction for Multimodal Entity Linking
abstract: arXiv:2611.24522v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal Entity Linking (MEL) aims to disambiguate mentions in multimodal contexts by grounding them to specific entities in a knowledge base. A pivotal challenge in MEL is capturing multi-level correspondences: the semantic consistency between mention-entity pairs and the complementary correlations across modalities. However, existing methods often suffer from element dominance due to their reliance on coupled interactions or coarse global aggregations. In response, we propose the Multi-Element Collaborative Interaction (MECI) framework. First, to capture multi-element mention-entity correspondences, we develop a Multi-view Experts Network that leverages a "divide-and-conquer" strategy for decoupled feature learning to mitigate element dominance, supported by a KL-guided routing mechanism that governs expert specialization and collaboration. translated_abstract: 多模态实体链接（MEL）旨在将多模态语境中的提及进行消歧，并将其链接到知识库中的特定实体。多模态实体链接的一个关键挑战是捕捉多层次的对应关系：即提及-实体对之间的语义一致性，以及跨模态之间的互补相关性。然而，现有方法由于依赖耦合交互或粗糙的全局聚合，往往存在“元素主导”问题。为此，我们提出了多元素协同交互（MECI）框架。首先，为了捕捉多元素的提及-实体对应关系，我们开发了多视图专家网络，利用“分而治之”策略进行解耦特征学习以缓解元素主导问题，并由KL引导的路由机制提供支持，该机制调控专家的专业化与协作。此外，为了建模跨模态互补相关性，我们提出了一种分层多……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出MECI框架，通过多视图专家网络和KL引导的路由机制进行解耦特征学习，缓解元素主导问题，从而更好地捕捉多模态实体链接中提及-实体的多层次对应关系和跨模态互补相关性。
en_tdlr: The MECI framework mitigates element dominance in multimodal entity linking by employing a Multi-view Experts Network with a KL-guided routing mechanism to better capture multi-level mention-entity correspondences and cross-modal complementary correlations.
